proposals.evidence: Turner places Hindi/Kumauni tum, Gujarati tame, Marathi tuhmī, Nepali timi, Assamese/Bengali tumi and Oriya tumbhi in the yuṣmad plural family (t- influenced by tuvam). These unmixed survey tum-/tam-/tom- responses fit the corresponding regional paradigms; multiword plurals and ambiguous singular to- forms are excluded.
